```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

This script computes the percentage of students excluded from each task by grade bin (Table 4). Each percentage is the number excluded at that step, divided by the number of students with a score on the task before any cleaning.

# Load libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

# Paths

```{r}
scores_dir <- here("data", "scores")
results_dir <- here("results")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

score_no_cleaning <- read.csv(file.path(scores_dir, "scores_combined_no_cleaning.csv"))              # before any cleaning
score_rtFiltered <- read.csv(file.path(scores_dir, "scores_combined_rtFiltered.csv"))                # students who did not pass the RT control removed
score_final <- read.csv(file.path(scores_dir, "scores_combined_rt-3-75_5-875-7917_math.csv"))        # fully cleaned
```

# Number of students with a score at each step

```{r}
task_counts <- function(scores, count_name){
  scores %>%
    mutate(grade_bin = case_when(user_grade_at_run %in% c("Kindergarten", "1") ~ "K-1",
                                 user_grade_at_run %in% c("2", "3", "4") ~ "2-4",
                                 user_grade_at_run %in% c("5","6") ~ "5-6",
                                 user_grade_at_run %in% c("7", "8") ~ "7-8",
                                 user_grade_at_run %in% c("9","10","11","12") ~ "9-12")) %>%
    dplyr::select(ID,grade_bin,arf_prod,arf_2afc,calf_prod,calf_6afc,rtControl_score_production,rtControl_score_2afc,rtControl_score_6afc) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -c(ID, grade_bin), names_to = "task", values_to = "score") %>%
    filter(!is.na(score)) %>%
    distinct(ID, grade_bin, task) %>%
    count(grade_bin, task, name = count_name)
}

tasks_count <- task_counts(score_no_cleaning, "initial_count") %>%
  full_join(task_counts(score_rtFiltered, "mid_count"), by = c("grade_bin", "task")) %>%
  full_join(task_counts(score_final, "final_count"), by = c("grade_bin", "task")) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(exc_count = mid_count - final_count,
         exc_perc = round((mid_count - final_count)/initial_count*100)) %>%
  filter(!(task == "rtControl_score_6afc" & grade_bin == "K-1"))

tasks_count
```

# Table 4: Exclusion percentage by grade bin

```{r}
table4 <- tasks_count %>%
  mutate(task = factor(task,
                       levels = c("arf_prod", "arf_2afc", "calf_prod", "calf_6afc", "rtControl_score_production", "rtControl_score_2afc", "rtControl_score_6afc"),
                       labels = c("arf_fr", "arf_fc", "calf_fr", "calf_fc", "rt_fr", "rt_2afc", "rt_6afc")),
         grade = factor(grade_bin, levels = c("K-1","2-4","5-6","7-8","9-12")),
         exc = paste0(exc_perc, "%")) %>%
  arrange(task) %>%
  dplyr::select(grade, task, exc) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = task, values_from = exc) %>%
  arrange(grade) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace_na(as.character(.), "")))

table4

write.csv(table4, file.path(results_dir, "table4_exclusion_grade_bin.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
